title: RunConfig
description:
Everything besides the corpus and scanner binaries that determines a run.
Its canonical digest is the run's `config_hash`.

methods.description:
Evaluation methods to apply (e.g. `twin`, `benign`, `mutation`,
`metamorphic`, `differential`). Sorted, unique.

scanners.description: Scanners to execute, in any order (results are sorted by id).

AccountingConfig.description:
Engine v1.1 accounting parameters (legacy `AccountingConfig`,
`benchmarks/types.ts:55-58`, values in `qualification/suite-v1.json`).
Floors withhold rates as `insufficient-evidence`/`insufficient-coverage`;
they are measurement rules, not support thresholds.

interval_precision.description: Decimal places of published points and bounds (1..=12).

interval_z.description: z value of the Wilson interval.

min_denominator.description: Smallest denominator for which a rate is published.

resolved_rate_floor.description: Minimum resolved share per method stratum.

twin_coverage_floor.description: Minimum twin coverage (pairs / positives) per kind.

version.description:
Adapter implementation version. Changes whenever parsing or offset
conversion changes.

jobs.description: Maximum concurrently running scanner jobs across all scanners (>= 1).

Floor.description: A floor: one value, or a default plus per-key overrides.

anyOf.description: The same floor for every key.

default.description: Floor for keys without an override.

oneOf.description: No network access is expected or permitted (default posture).
The run explicitly authorizes network access (e.g. verification).

ScannerLimits.description: Per-scanner bounds. Every limit is explicit; there are no unbounded defaults.

concurrency.description: Maximum concurrent invocations of this scanner (>= 1).

max_stdout_bytes.description: Maximum captured stdout bytes; exceeding it is a `malformed`/`error` state.

timeout_ms.description: Wall-clock timeout per scanner invocation, in milliseconds.

ScannerSpec.description: How one scanner is to be executed.

adapter.description: Adapter that executes and normalizes this scanner.

configuration.description:
Adapter-specific configuration. Recorded verbatim and hashed; it must
not contain credentials.

id.description: Scanner id, unique within the run.

mode.description: Human-readable scanner mode (e.g. "directory scan, default rules").

network.description:
Whether the scanner may use the network. Verification calls are off
unless a run explicitly authorizes them.
